neighbours.label: ' cost' used as a verb of monetary harm: something bad cost a party a large sum (fraud cost retailers $X billion)
fire: In 2019, ransomware attacks cost hospitals more than $7 billion.
Drought has cost ranchers in the region hundreds of millions.
Employee theft alone cost American shops about $50 billion last year.
The strike cost the airline an estimated $300 million.
Experts say traffic congestion costs the economy billions annually.
Invasive beetles cost the timber industry millions of dollars every year.
Medical errors cost insurers vast sums in extra treatment.
The outage cost online retailers nearly $90 million in sales.
quiet: In 2019, ransomware attacks hit more than 700 hospitals.
Drought has forced ranchers in the region to sell herds.
Employee theft alone was reported by most American shops last year.
The strike grounded the airline for an entire week.
Experts say traffic congestion slows the economy annually.
Invasive beetles damage the timber forests every year.
Medical errors harm patients in many hospitals.
The outage frustrated online shoppers for nearly an hour.
